name: Ridgeline Facility Services LLC
notes:
Ridgeline Facility Services LLC is a woman-owned small business based in San Antonio, Texas, with 42 employees.

We are certified by the SBA as a Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB). We are also a HUB-certified vendor with the State of Texas.

Our primary NAICS code is 561720 Janitorial Services. We also work under NAICS 561730 Landscaping Services and NAICS 238220 Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors.

We provide janitorial and custodial services, floor care, green cleaning with EPA Safer Choice products, grounds maintenance, and HVAC preventive maintenance for office buildings, clinics, and schools.

Past performance: Since 2021 we have provided daily custodial services for the Bexar County Health Clinic network, covering 6 clinic sites and 140,000 square feet, under a $1.2M three-year contract.

Past performance: We maintain grounds and landscaping for Northside Independent School District at 9 campuses under a $380,000 annual contract.

Past performance: We delivered quarterly HVAC preventive maintenance for a 4-building office park for Alamo Property Group from 2022 to 2024, valued at $210,000.

All supervisors complete OSHA 10-hour training and our staff pass background checks. We carry $2M general liability insurance.

We serve the San Antonio and Austin metro areas, including Bexar, Travis, and Comal counties.
